purpose.zh: 练胸部，让两臂往中间合的力量更强
purpose.en: Build your chest and a stronger squeeze bringing your arms together.

text.zh: 手肘微弯别动，两臂往两边打开再合拢
text.en: Keep your elbows softly bent and open your arms wide, then bring them together

text.zh: 仰卧屈膝，双脚踩地，哑铃从胸口上方开始。
text.en: Lie on your back, knees bent and feet flat, dumbbells above your chest.

text.zh: 大臂轻碰地面就停，不要弹起来。
text.en: Stop when your upper arms touch the floor, without bouncing.

commonErrors.zh: 手肘一弯一直，变成了推
commonErrors.en: Bending and straightening the elbows into a press.
Bouncing the arms off the floor.

cautions.en: Start with a light weight, and stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 肩膀前面夹着疼时打开少一点
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, open less wide.

changes: 手算相位（见 flags），顶点 0.4 s → rep_updown
补「哑铃从胸口上方开始」和常见错误「砸地弹起」
flags: 批表 press 轨从 1（手臂在上）开始，相位方向反了；按 spec 关键帧手算：放下 1.8、底部停 0.4、推回 1.3、顶部 0.5，请确认（飞鸟 spec 是烘焙轨，按 press 同节奏读出：约 0.47→1.97 打开、1.97→2.63 底部、2.63→3.7 合拢）
